description: This file defines a C# class 'SqlServerStorageForTesting' that extends 'RelationalStorageForTesting' to provide SQL Server-specific testing utilities, including database creation, deletion, existence checks, and setup script conversion.

classes.name: SqlServerStorageForTesting
classes.description: A test utility class for SQL Server storage, providing methods for database setup, teardown, and configuration tailored for testing scenarios.

methods.name: SqlServerStorageForTesting
methods.description: Constructor initializing the storage with a connection string and setting the provider moniker.

methods.name: CancellationTestQuery
methods.description: Returns a SQL query string used to test cancellation behavior, involving a delay.

methods.name: CreateStreamTestTable
methods.description: Returns a SQL command string to create a test streaming table.

methods.name: CreateDatabaseTemplate
methods.description: Provides a template SQL command for creating a new database with specific file paths and size settings.

methods.name: DropDatabaseTemplate
methods.description: Provides a template SQL command for dropping a database.

methods.name: ExistsDatabaseTemplate
methods.description: Provides a SQL query to check if a database exists.

methods.name: ConvertToExecutableBatches
methods.description: Converts a setup script into executable SQL batches, appending recovery mode change and test table creation commands.
